name: Pecca Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，Pecca Group Berhad 在汽车板块持续推进 IR4.0 智能制造评估，其子公司 Pecca Leather 获得 MARii 的 Auto-SMART 计划 Level 3（1-Star Badge）；航空板块则与 Betamek Research 就机上娱乐系统（IFE）及铁路乘客信息娱乐系统（PIES）的潜在合作持续进行讨论，但截至公告日尚未达成任何具体项目或最终协议。集团层面未见新增或退出整条业务线的公告。
overview_en: In 2026, Pecca Group Berhad continued its IR4.0 smart manufacturing assessment in the automotive segment, with subsidiary Pecca Leather receiving Level 3 (1-Star Badge) under MARii's Auto-SMART programme; in the aviation segment, it continued discussions with Betamek Research on potential collaboration in In-Flight Entertainment (IFE) and rail Passenger Information Entertainment System (PIES), but no specific project or definitive agreement had been finalised as of the announcement dates.

segments.name: 汽车产品
segments.note: 今年主要参与 MARii 的智能制造评估计划及行业展会，以推进 IR4.0 相关能力建设。
segments.note_en: This year, the segment mainly participated in MARii's smart manufacturing assessment programme and industry expos to advance IR4.0-related capabilities.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 公司于2025年9月22日在 Pecca Leather 制造设施接待23名 MARii 员工进行工厂参观（MARiiShare 计划），MARii 主席兼 CEO 于2025年9月24日到访。
actions.text_en: The company hosted 23 MARii staff for a plant visit at Pecca Leather's manufacturing facility on 22 September 2025 under the MARiiShare initiative, and the Chairman and CEO of MARii paid a courtesy visit on 24 September 2025.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Pecca Leather 参加2026年8月26日至28日由 MARii 联合主办的 Global Automotive and Technology Expo 2026（GATE 2026），在 MIDA 展馆展示其能力及对 AI 应用的承诺。
actions.text_en: Pecca Leather participated in the Global Automotive and Technology Expo 2026 (GATE 2026), co-organised by MARii and held from 26 to 28 August 2026, showcasing its capabilities and commitment to AI adoption under the MIDA Pavilion.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Pecca Leather 于2026年5月13日完成 Auto-SMART 现场评估，计划于2026年7月13日结束，并获颁 Level 3（1-Star Badge）。
actions.text_en: Pecca Leather completed the Auto-SMART on-site assessment on 13 May 2026; the programme concluded on 13 July 2026 and Pecca Leather was awarded Level 3 (1-Star Badge).

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Pecca Leather 获得 MARii 供应商竞争力等级（SCL）Level 5，并获邀参加计划于2026年5月举行的 Auto-SMART 计划评估。
actions.text_en: Pecca Leather obtained Level 5 in MARii's Supplier Competitiveness Level (SCL) and was offered the opportunity to participate in the Auto-SMART programme assessment scheduled for May 2026.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Pecca Leather 代表参加 MARii 于2025年11月12日至14日在吉隆坡会议中心举办的 Global Automotive and Technology Expo（GATE），与潜在业务伙伴接触。
actions.text_en: Representatives of Pecca Leather participated in the Global Automotive and Technology Expo (GATE) organised by MARii from 12 to 14 November 2025 at the Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre, engaging with potential business partners.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: PASSB 与 Betamek Research 继续探索潜在合作领域，但截至公告日尚未敲定具体项目、商业安排或最终协议，合作无重大进展。
actions.text_en: PASSB and Betamek Research continued to explore potential areas of collaboration, but as of the announcement date no specific project, commercial arrangement or definitive agreement had been finalised, and there had been no material development from the collab…

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: PASSB 与 Betamek Research 在2026年第一季度末进行一系列讨论，重点评估航空 IFE 系统及铁路 PIES 解决方案的合作机会。
actions.text_en: PASSB and Betamek Research held a series of discussions in late first quarter of 2026, focusing on evaluating collaboration opportunities in aviation IFE systems and rail PIES solutions.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: PASSB 与 Betamek Research 持续进行工作层讨论，重点完善航空及铁路板块的商业策略，包括 IFE 及 PIES 的初步定位。
actions.text_en: PASSB and Betamek Research continued working-level discussions focused on refining the commercial strategy for the aviation and rail segments, including preliminary positioning of IFE and PIES solutions.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: PASSB 与 Betamek Research 于2025年10月24日、11月11日及11月28日举行三次联合头脑风暴会议，探讨航空 IFE 及铁路 PIES 解决方案的联合商业计划。
actions.text_en: PASSB and Betamek Research held three joint brainstorming sessions on 24 October, 11 November and 28 November 2025 to explore a joint business plan for aviation IFE and rail PIES solutions.
